snippet.title: Revenge On Gold Diggers is Now Available on Consoles
snippet.description: The 'game' continues! The highest-selling FMV of 2025, Emotional Anti-Fraud Simulator, is now available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, and the Windows Store, featuring updated English localization and newly added Traditional Chinese support, along with support for PlayStation Remote Play, Xbox Cloud Gaming, and Xbox Play Anywhere.
